why: gorge's payment planner prices a sacrifice-another-creature mana source as a last-resort step (pay/planshape.go, victims ranked tokens first, then lowest mana value, then id) and offers every cast it alone makes payable, with the victims in the plan; dirac's planner has no such source tier, so it withholds those casts (and, on the full surface, differs in what the plan sacrifices) (tail-73 pair 10 of the seed 3 Phyrexian Tower focus run: paying Warden of the First Tree's activation, dirac's plan taps the tower and sacrifices a 4/4, gorge's does not)
